blocks.text: Grade 9 高频词汇 601–700
monopoly /mə'nɒpəli/ n. 垄断, 专卖权, 独占事业；[经] 垄断, 专利品, 垄断(权)独占
The right of every businessman, large and small, to trade in an atmosphere of freedom from unfair competition and domination by monopolies at home or abroad;
中文语境：每个商人，无论大小，都有权在不受国内外不公平竞争和垄断统治的自由氛围中进行贸易；
domination /.dɒmi'neiʃən/ n. 支配, 控制, 管辖
The right of every businessman, large and small, to trade in an atmosphere of freedom from unfair competition and domination by monopolies at home or abroad;
中文语境：每个商人，无论大小，都有权在不受国内外不公平竞争和垄断统治的自由氛围中进行贸易；
inadequate /in'ædikwət/ adj. 不充分的, 不适当的；[法] 不充分的, 不适当的
As our nation has grown in size and stature, however - as our industrial economy expanded - these political rights proved inadequate to assure us equality in the pursuit of happiness.
中文语境：然而，随着我们国家的规模和地位不断增长，随着我们工业经济的扩张，这些政治权利被证明不足以确保我们在追求幸福方面的平等
petroleum /pə'trəuliəm/ n. 石油；[化] 石油
and now when I see the man from British Petroleum
中文语境：现在当我看到英国石油公司的那个人时
trespass /'trespəs/ n. 擅自进入, 非法侵入, 侵害；v.i. 侵害, 侵入, 打扰, 冒犯
for our trespasses,
中文语境：对于我们的过犯，
distortion /dis'tɒːʃən/ n. 扭曲, 变形, 曲解；[计] 畸变; 失真
the reflections and distortions of us,
中文语境：我们的反思和扭曲，
mosaic /məu'zeiik/ n. 马赛克, 镶嵌细工, 镶嵌工艺；adj. 马赛克的, 镶嵌细工的, 拼花的；v.t. 用镶嵌细工装饰；[计] Mosaic浏览程序
the mosaic growth of shell
中文语境：贝壳的花叶生长
splendor /'splendə/ n. 光辉, 壮丽, 显赫
in the ocean of splendor and light,
中文语境：在辉煌与光明的海洋中，
intelligence /in'telidʒəns/ n. 智力, 情报, 信息；[医] 智力
the eyes of another intelligence
中文语境：另一种智慧的眼睛
disinfection /.disin'fekʃən/ n. 消毒；[医] 消毒
Courtesy of the custodial medical kit, Jenny Balak's hand had received disinfection and bandaging; Newton and Brocklehurst had supervised its wrapping until the fingers disappeared into a gauzy mitt.
中文语境：在保管医疗箱的帮助下，珍妮·巴拉克的手接受了消毒和包扎；牛顿和布罗克赫斯特监督了它的包裹，直到手指消失在薄纱手套中
feline /'fiːlain/ adj. 猫的, 猫科的, 猫一样的；n. 猫, 猫科动物
When it comes to revealing when and how wild felines became couch kitties, the cat is starting to come out of the bag.
中文语境：当谈到揭示野生猫科动物何时以及如何变成沙发猫时，猫科动物的秘密已经开始泄露
tame /teim/ adj. 驯服的, 柔顺的, 被开垦的, 顺从的, 乏味的, 平淡的；v.t. 驯养, 驯服, 制服, 失去锋芒；v.i. 变得驯服
Cats were likely first tamed in the Middle East.
中文语境：猫很可能首先在中东被驯服
span /spæn/ n. 指距, 全长, 跨距, 一段时间, 小范围；v.t. 以手指测量, 跨越, 架设, 持续

Geigl, Grange and their colleagues collected mitochondrial DNA from 352 ancient cats and 28 modern wildcats. These felines spanned 9,000 years. They came from regions stretching across Europe, Africa and Southwest Asia.
中文语境：Geigl、Grange 及其同事收集了 352 只古代猫科动物和 28 只现代野猫的线粒体 DNA。这些猫科动物的历史跨越了 9000 年。他们来自欧洲、非洲和西南亚地区
mutually /'mjuːtʃuəli/ adv. 互相地, 互助
The arrangement would have been "mutually profitable for both sides," explains Grange.
中文语境：格兰奇解释说，这种安排"对双方来说都是互惠互利的"
prologue /'prəulɒːg/ n. 开场白, 序言, 序幕；v.t. 为...作序, 加上...前言
After that prologue, the judges take their places on the bench, and using a condensed version of the official Supreme Court transcript, they play the roles of the justices who heard the case.
中文语境：序言结束后，法官们就座，并使用最高法院官方笔录的精简版，扮演审理该案的法官的角色
disruptive /dis'rʌptiv/ adj. 分裂的, 破坏(性)的；[计] 击穿的, 中断的

Supreme Court ruled by a 7-to-2 vote for Tinker, affirming the principle that schoolchildren do not "shed their constitutional rights to freedom of speech or expression at the schoolhouse gate." Students cannot be censored, the court said, unless their speech is disruptive.
中文语境：最高法院以 7 比 2 的投票结果支持了 Tinker，确认学童不得"在校舍门口放弃言论或表达自由的宪法权利"这一原则。法院表示，学生不能受到审查，除非他们的言论具有破坏性
provocative /prə'vɒkətiv/ adj. 激发感情的, 挑拨的, 刺激的；n. 刺激物, 挑拨物, 兴奋剂
"I think we'd have to look at how provocative the message actually was."
中文语境："我认为我们必须看看这条信息实际上有多具有挑衅性。"
concede /kən'siːd/ v.t. 承认, 退让；v.i. 让步
Judge Srinivasan jumps in: "Counsel, I suppose that you would concede that if the armband started fistfights, a principal could prohibit students from wearing them."
中文语境：斯里尼瓦桑法官插话道："律师，我想您会承认，如果臂章引发打斗，校长可以禁止学生佩戴臂章。"
burial /'beriəl/ n. 埋葬, 葬礼；[法] 埋葬, 葬礼
I prepared him for burial; by then, Harvey Milk
中文语境：我为他准备了埋葬；到那时，哈维·米尔克
hardihood /'hɑːdihud/ n. 胆大无敌, 刚毅, 厚颜, 强壮
"I exaggerate nothing," continued Ferguson, "for, upon reading the narratives of such travellers as have had the hardihood to venture into these regions, your eyes would fill with tears."
中文语境："我没有夸大其词，"弗格森继续说道，"因为，在读到那些勇敢地冒险进入这些地区的旅行者的叙述时，你的眼睛会充满泪水。"
droll /drɒl/ adj. 好笑的, 滑稽的, 逗趣的
"I move that we don't try it!" said Joe, in his droll way.
中文语境："我建议我们不要尝试！"乔用他滑稽的方式说道
superb /sju'pəːb/ adj. 极度的, 华丽的, 极好的
The vapors rolled over each other, and mingled together in confused masses of superb brilliance, as they reflected the rays of the sun.
中文语境：当它们反射着太阳的光芒时，蒸气相互翻滚，并混合在一起，形成极其明亮的混乱物质
treachery /'tretʃəri/ n. 背叛, 变节；[法] 背叛, 变节, 背信弃义

My loving people, we have been persuaded by some, that are careful of our safety, to take heed how we commit ourselves to armed multitudes, for fear of treachery; but I assure you, I do not desire to live to distrust my faithful and loving people.
中文语境：我亲爱的人民，我们被一些关心我们安全的人说服，要注意我们如何将自己交给武装群众，以免遭到背叛；但我向你保证，我不想活着就不再信任我忠实而有爱心的人民
valor /'vælə/ n. 英勇, 刚勇, 勇猛

In the mean my lieutenant general shall be in my stead, than whom never prince commanded a more noble and worthy subject; not doubting by your obedience to my general, by your concord in the camp, and by your valor in the field, we shall shortly have a famous victory over the enemies of my God, of my kingdom, and of my people.
中文语境：总而言之，我的中将将接替我的位置，没有哪个王子指挥过比他更高贵、更有价值的臣民。毫无疑问，凭借你们对我将军的服从，你们在营中的和谐，以及你们在战场上的英勇，我们很快就会对我的上帝、我的王国和我的人民的敌人取得一场著名的胜利
safeguard /'seifgɑːd/ n. 保卫, 保护措施, 防护设施；v.t. 保卫, 保护
Let tyrants fear; I have always so behaved myself that, under God, I have placed my chiefest strength and safeguard in the loyal hearts and good will of my subjects.
中文语境：让暴君畏惧；我一向如此行事，在上帝的领导下，我把我最大的力量和保障放在我臣民的忠诚的心和善意中
tyrant /'taiərənt/ n. 暴君；[法] 专制君主, 暴君, 压制他人者
Let tyrants fear; I have always so behaved myself that, under God, I have placed my chiefest strength and safeguard in the loyal hearts and good will of my subjects.
中文语境：让暴君畏惧；我一向如此行事，在上帝的领导下，我把我最大的力量和保障放在我臣民的忠诚的心和善意中
multitude /'mʌltitjuːd/ n. 多数, 群众

My loving people, we have been persuaded by some, that are careful of our safety, to take heed how we commit ourselves to armed multitudes, for fear of treachery; but I assure you, I do not desire to live to distrust my faithful and loving people.
中文语境：我亲爱的人民，我们被一些关心我们安全的人说服，要注意我们如何将自己交给武装群众，以免遭到背叛；但我向你保证，我不想活着就不再信任我忠实而有爱心的人民
commit /kə'mit/ v.t. 委托(托付), 犯罪, 指派...作战, 使承担义务；[法] 犯, 做, 把...交托给

My loving people, we have been persuaded by some, that are careful of our safety, to take heed how we commit ourselves to armed multitudes, for fear of treachery; but I assure you, I do not desire to live to distrust my faithful and loving people.
中文语境：我亲爱的人民，我们被一些关心我们安全的人说服，要注意我们如何将自己交给武装群众，以免遭到背叛；但我向你保证，我不想活着就不再信任我忠实而有爱心的人民
placate /plə'keit/ v.t. 抚慰, 平息, 使和解, 怀柔
"That's true, honey," she leapt to say, in her most placating voice.
中文语境："确实如此，亲爱的，"她用她最安抚的声音说道
ensconce /in'skɒns/ v.t. 安顿下来, 安置, 使隐藏
The decision to forsake the public high school, where Netha was already comfortably ensconced, had also resulted in a lot of hushed, dramatic parent conversations.
中文语境：放弃公立高中的决定也导致了许多安静而戏剧性的家长对话，内莎已经舒适地安顿在公立高中
pathological /,pæθə'lɔdʒikəl/ adj. 病理学的, 由疾病引起的, (非正式)不合理的, 仅由想象引起的, 不理智的；[计] 错误的
They expected that only 4 percent would reach 300 volts, and that only a pathological fringe of about one in a thousand would administer the highest shock on the board.
中文语境：他们预计只有 4% 的电压会达到 300 伏，并且只有大约千分之一的病态边缘才会对板上产生最高的冲击
dissolute /'disəljut/ adj. 放荡的, 风流的
About fifty-years-old and unemployed at the time of the experiment, he has a good-natured, if slightly dissolute, appearance, and he strikes people as a rather ordinary fellow.
中文语境：实验时他大约五十岁，失业，外表善良，但略显放荡，给人的印象是一个相当普通的人
pivot /'pivət/ n. 枢轴, 支点, 旋转运动, 中枢, 关键人物；adj. 枢轴的, (如)在枢轴上转动的；v.i. 在枢轴上转动, 随着转移；v.t. 装枢轴于, 以...为中心旋转；[计] 程序员交互验证和编制工具, 数据透视表
After delivering the 180-volt shock, he pivots around in the chair and, shaking his head, addresses the experimenter in agitated tones:
中文语境：施加 180 伏电击后，他在椅子上转了一圈，摇着头，用激动的语气对实验者说道：
relevance /'relivəns/ n. 中肯；关联；相关性

A colleague of mine immediately dismissed these findings as having no relevance to "ordinary" people, asserting that Yale undergraduates are a highly aggressive, competitive bunch who step on each other's necks on the slightest provocation.
中文语境：我的一位同事立即驳斥了这些发现，认为这些发现与"普通"人无关，并声称耶鲁大学的本科生是一群极具攻击性、竞争性的群体，只要受到最轻微的挑衅，他们就会互相掐脖子
intrinsic /in'trinsik/ adj. 本质的, 原有的, 真正的；[医] 内部的, 内在的

It is not possible to be a scientist unless you believe that the knowledge of the world, and the power which this gives, is a thing which is of intrinsic value to humanity, and that you are using it to help in the spread of knowledge, and are willing to take the consequences.
中文语境：除非你相信世界的知识及其所赋予的力量对人类具有内在价值，并且你正在利用它来帮助传播知识，并愿意承担后果，否则不可能成为一名科学家
embroil /im'brɒil/ v.t. 使卷入, 牵连

By the time it ended four years later, it had embroiled 14 "Allies," including the U.S., Great Britain, France and Russia, and four "Central Powers"-primarily Austria-Hungary, Germany, and the Ottoman Empire.
中文语境：到四年后结束时，它已经卷入了包括美国、英国、法国和俄罗斯在内的 14 个"同盟国"和四个"同盟国"--主要是奥匈帝国、德国和奥斯曼帝国
plunder /'plʌndə/ n. 抢夺, 掠夺品, 战利品；v. 掠夺, 抢劫, 抢夺
An Iowa-born Quaker, Hoover set out to save European lives after the war started and Belgium, which was plundered by the German army, began suffering severe food shortages.
中文语境：胡佛是爱荷华州出生的贵格会教徒，战争爆发后，被德国军队掠夺的比利时开始遭受严重的粮食短缺，胡佛着手拯救欧洲人的生命
articulate /ɑː'tikjulit/ adj. 发音清晰的, 口才好的；v.t. 明白地说, 以关节连接, 使成为系统的整体
President Woodrow Wilson, who articulated the Allies' war aims and helped negotiate the ultimate peace treaty.
中文语境：伍德罗·威尔逊总统，阐明了盟军的战争目标并帮助谈判达成了最终的和平条约
damn /dæm/ n. 一点, 诅咒, 丝毫；interj. 该死, 该死的；v.t. 诅咒, 罚...下地狱；v.i. 指责, 谴责, 骂...该死, 证明...有罪
He answered that he was ready to help, "but I'll be damned if I'll give up my American citizenship-not on your life!"
中文语境：他回答说他已经准备好提供帮助，"但是如果我放弃我的美国公民身份，那我就该死了--而不是你的生命！"
include /in'kluːd/ v.t. 包括, 把...算入, 包住；[计] DOS内部命令:在CONFIG.SYS文件的一个配置块中包含另一配置块的内容

By the time it ended four years later, it had embroiled 14 "Allies," including the U.S., Great Britain, France and Russia, and four "Central Powers"-primarily Austria-Hungary, Germany, and the Ottoman Empire.
中文语境：到四年后结束时，它已经卷入了包括美国、英国、法国和俄罗斯在内的 14 个"同盟国"和四个"同盟国"--主要是奥匈帝国、德国和奥斯曼帝国
cutting /'kʌtiŋ/ n. 切断, 切下, 路堑；[化] 切屑
Someone tossed a burning match or cigarette into a big pail of scrapped cuttings, and the highly flammable material burst into a furious fire.
中文语境：有人将一根燃烧的火柴或香烟扔进一大桶废弃的碎屑中，高度易燃的材料突然燃起熊熊大火
deviant /'diːviənt/ adj. 不正常的；n. 不正常的人(或物)
The courts prosecute not only criminals, but also political deviants, often without a fair trial.
中文语境：法院不仅起诉罪犯，还起诉政治越轨者，但往往没有经过公正的审判
callous /'kæləs/ adj. 麻木的, 无情的, 坚硬的, 硬皮的, 起老茧的；v.t. 使生茧, 使变硬

Finally, Ames suggested that the spies he betrayed ran similar risks of being discovered as he had run, and therefore their fate was nothing to feel guilty about: "That is a callous thing to say, but there is a certain amount of truth to that...These two guys in the K.G.B.
中文语境：最后，艾姆斯表示，他背叛的间谍也面临着与他逃跑时类似的被发现风险，因此他们的命运没有什么值得感到内疚的："这话虽然冷酷无情，但也有一定的道理......克格勃的这两个家伙
delude /di'luːd/ v.t. 迷惑, 蛊惑
deluding ourselves politically and convincing ourselves that we have a special mission..."
中文语境：在政治上欺骗自己，让自己相信我们有一个特殊的使命......"
justification /.dʒʌstifi'keiʃən/ n. 辩护, 证明正当, 释罪；[计] 调整
Ames' answers below highlight the reasons - and, to Ames, justification for - his betrayals:
中文语境：艾姆斯的以下回答强调了他背叛的原因 - 并且对艾姆斯来说，是他背叛的理由：
perishable /'periʃəbl/ adj. 易腐坏的, 会枯萎的, 易毁灭的, 不经久的；n. 易腐坏的东西
We long ago sold the electric refrigerator which came with our house and bought an antique ice box to keep our perishables fresh.
中文语境：我们很久以前就卖掉了房子里的电冰箱，买了一个古董冰盒来保持易腐烂的东西新鲜
homely /'həumli/ adj. 家常的, 平凡的, 朴实无华的

...utensils, and antique furniture, have appealed to me with peculiar force, telling facts and relating incidents to me in such a plain, homely but graphic manner of the every-day life of our ancestors, that I look upon them more as text-books than as curiosities; for it is only by the light of truth reflected from these objects that we are...
中文语境：......器皿和古董家具以一种特殊的力量吸引着我，它们以一种简单、朴素但生动的方式向我讲述了我们祖先日常生活的事实和事件，以至于我将它们视为教科书而不是好奇心；因为只有通过从这些物体反射的真理之光，我们才是......
immersion /i'məːʃən/ n. 沉浸, 专心, 陷入；[医] 浸, 浸渍
Some tribes have programs that allow young students to experience daily language immersion with elders who learned the original language growing up.
中文语境：一些部落制定了一些计划，允许年轻学生与在成长过程中学习母语的长辈一起体验日常语言沉浸
proficiency /prə'fiʃəns/ n. 精通, 熟练, 精练
Their proficiency struck blows at previous race-based policies in the military; they soon needed to undergo highly advanced training that African Americans had previously been barred from receiving.
中文语境：他们的熟练程度对以前军队中基于种族的政策造成了打击；他们很快就需要接受非裔美国人以前被禁止接受的高级培训
squadron /'skwɒdrən/ n. 骑兵营, 分遣队, 小舰队
The 332nd Fighter Group became one of the most successful squadrons of fighter planes in the Army.
中文语境：第332战斗机大队成为陆军最成功的战斗机中队之一
tutor /'tjuːtə/ n. 家庭教师, 导师, 助教, 监护人；v.t. 当...的教师, 教, 指导, 约束, 克制；v.i. 当家庭教师, 受家庭教师的指导
Alfred "Chief" Anderson, who had become an unofficial leader and tutor in the group because of his skills.
中文语境：阿尔弗雷德"酋长"安德森，由于他的技能而成为该团体的非官方领导者和导师
escort /'eskɒːt/ n. 护送者, 护卫者, 护航舰；v.t. 护卫, 护送
In later assignments, they became most famous for their ability to escort larger bomber planes.
中文语境：在后来的任务中，他们因护航大型轰炸机的能力而闻名
dodge /dɒdʒ/ v. 避开, 躲避；n. 诡计, 躲藏
I try to dodge all the darts that you're throwing at me,
中文语境：我试图躲开你向我投掷的所有飞镖，
persecution /.pəːsi'kjuːʃən/ n. 虐待, 迫害运动, 迫害, 烦扰；[法] 迫害, 虐待, 困扰
I question why the truth has led to persecution.
